newsitem.title: KENYA: Aid staff in Goma, Zaire to gather for evacuation.
newsitem.headline: Aid staff in Goma, Zaire to gather for evacuation.

text.p: Aid agency workers in the east Zaire town of Goma have been told to gather at concentration points in the city on Friday for possible evacuation, an aid worker said.

Michele Quintaglie of the World Food Programme told Reuters by telephone from Goma: "Aid agencies have been advised to move to concentration points. It is an indication that the evacuation might take place today."
Aid workers said on Thursday they had been told to prepare for evacuation, but it had not been clear when the evacuation might take place.
On Thursday fierce battles between Tutsi rebels and Zairean troops raged just north of the city.
A pullout by the aid agencies would have serious consequences for the Rwandan refugees in Zaire.
"There are 700,000 people who clearly need assistance. We are very worried about what will happen to these people," she said.
